brief: A Mac app that restyles Apple Wallet card art on iPhone. Premium, modern, next-gen.
criteria: Ownable, abstract, strong at 16 px, works reversed. Purple on a dark tile.

concepts.name: Overlap · Purple
concepts.idea: Two surfaces overlap and a new window opens where they meet.
rationale: Purple mark on a dark tile — matches the site
Holds from 512 px to a 16 px favicon
Abstract — not a card, not a V

recommendation: Overlap in purple on dark — premium and cohesive with the current site.
next_steps: Wire into favicon, app icon and site header
Outline the wordmark from a geometric typeface
